programs.title: Vinci 2
programs.desc: Cuma receives an offer to participate in a new heist.At first he refuses, but changes his mind when he learns that his old rival, Chudy, is planning a spectacular robbery in Krakow without his participation.

programs.title: The Karate Kid
programs.desc: Teenage Daniel (Ralph Macchio) moves with his mother, Lucille (Randee Heller), from New Jersey to Los Angeles.He becomes friends with his peer Tommy (Rob Garrison).During a beach party, the boy meets a nice blonde, Ali (Elisabeth Shue).The two immediately take a liking to each other, which does not please her ex-boyfriend, Johnny (William Zabka).As an excellent karateka, he easily teaches his rival a lesson.Humiliated, Daniel also decides to start training eastern martial arts to defeat the enemy.Unfortunately, he cannot join the local club because Johnny and his equally unpleasant and brutal friends practice there.One evening, Daniel is attacked by them again.He is saved from trouble by an old man, Mr. Miyagi (Noriyuki "Pat" Morita), who turns out to be a master of eastern martial arts.From then on, the teenager learns the secrets of karate under his watchful eye.The Japanese teaches him not only the fighting style, but also a lot about life... A perfect film for karate lovers.For his role as Master Noriyuki "Pat" Morita, he received an Oscar nomination for Best Supporting Actor and a Golden Globe nomination.Director of photography John G. Avildsen is known as the creator of the legendary "Rocky" from 1976 with Sylvester Stallone.

actor: Mr. Kesuke Miyagi - Noriyuki Pat Morita
John Kreese Cobra Kai Sensei - Martin Kove

programs.title: Penguins of Madagascar
programs.desc: The supporting penguin agents known from the three parts of "Madagascar" return to the cinema screen in their own production.Great entertainment for younger and older viewers guaranteed.Skipper, Kowalski, Rico and Private engage in a mission on which the fate of the world depends.They must face the geneticist Oktawiusz Mackiewicz, who dreams of controlling the Earth.In fact, the enemy of flightless birds is a vengeful octopus.It intends to settle accounts with visitors from Antarctica.Penguin agents join forces with the secret organization North Wind, which includes: the Greenland seal Detonator, the muscular teddy bear Kapral and the snowy owl Ewa.They are commanded by the mysterious Arctic Wolf, the Covert Agent.Good company awakens the competitive spirit in Skipper.As befits real superspies, the flightless unit travels halfway around the world.He visits, among others:Venice, Antarctica, Shanghai and New York.

programs.title: Little Emma
programs.desc: A little girl named Emma was raised by animals.Her life is full of warmth and joy until one of her friends discovers the unpleasant truth that she was actually adopted and is not part of their family.Devastated, Emma sets out on a journey to find her loved ones.Along the way, he gathers an extraordinary team, including the clumsy inventor Żółwik Bystrzak, the ambitious scientist Edward Wilk and the brave Weasel Sancho.Together they are looking for a mysterious island which, according to legend, is inhabited by tiny people.

programs.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
programs.desc: After Dumbledore's death, Harry does not return to Hogwarts.He also breaks up with Ginny.Together with Hermione and Ron, he has to complete a mission entrusted to them by the deceased professor.Magic adepts must find horcruxes - mysterious objects in which Voldemort hid parts of his soul.Dumbledore left them things that could help them with their task.Unfortunately, they have no idea how to use them.At the same time, Harry tries to find out what the mysterious Deathly Hallows are that the Dark Lord is looking for.Without the support of mentors, he must rely on his friends more than ever.Meanwhile, the Ministry of Magic and Hogwarts fall under Voldemort's power.The school is now run by his right-hand man, Severus Snape.This means danger for students who do not come from wizarding families.Potter, Hermione and Ron must hide from Death Eaters.Soon Ron leaves his friends for unknown reasons.Harry and Hermione continue their journey alone.They go to Godric's Hollow, where the Potters lived.
